pop_a.tgeno and pop_b.tgeno are inst/extdata/pop_a.geno and pop_b.geno
(packedancestrymap GENO files) converted to the TGENO layout with EIGENSOFT's
own code: genotype_matrix_read_file() and genotype_matrix_write_packed_file()
(with transpose = true), from src/geno.c of https://github.com/DReichLab/EIG
(master, downloaded 25 Nov 2026), compiled with a small main():

  genotype_matrix g;
  genotype_matrix_read_file(&g, "pop_a.geno", 0, NULL, NULL);
  genotype_matrix_write_packed_file(&g, "pop_a.tgeno", true);

Converting them back to GENO the same way gives files identical to the
originals. They use the .snp and .ind files of inst/extdata.
